title: Reachability in the padded graph
statement: Let $r$ be a decidable symmetric relation on $\text{Fin}(n)$, and let $D$ be a natural number with $n \le D$. For any $s,t \in \text{Fin}(n)$, there is a finite sequence of padded-graph adjacency steps from $s$ to $t$ (allowing a sequence of length zero) if and only if there is a finite sequence of $r$-related steps from $s$ to $t$, also allowing length zero.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number n and a decidable relation r on Fin(n)
Vertices s and t in Fin(n)
